title: A reply that proposes a fixed time or count as a target or limit, with no ruling cited, is held at Stop
why: Incident 11:35 CST Nov 13 (retrospective): it proposed fixed CI targets (5 min docs-only, 15 min code) to runner 10. Owner 11:36 CST, verbatim: "these hard static time limits are not something i approve or am a fan of, you should know this". It breaks R37 (Nov 11, retire unruled fixed numbers). Withdrawn 11:37. Owner message logged as fb-1136-4.
note: Step fixed-number-limits-census covers limits already in code, not new ones a session proposes. Guard: a reply or send_message that proposes a fixed time or count as a target or limit, with no ruling cited, is held at Stop. The remedy names a measured gold instead (before and after, or a derived floor). Checked at Stop on the reply text only; no timer, no log. Needs a false-alarm test: a measured figure with its sample count must pass.
